title: OKR Lattice & Decision Thresholds for Hosted API Model Catalog — Q2 Execution Plan
creator: Maya Patel
project: Hosted API Model Catalog Roadmap Q2 2026
description: Purpose: produce a compact, actionable Q2 execution plan that ties model-catalog changes to explicit OKR outcomes and decision thresholds. Scope: (1) define the OKR lattice — which catalog changes map to revenue-critical, reliability, and cost OKRs; (2) define quantitative decision thresholds (latency/99, token-cost delta, quality regression delta) that gate canaries and promote model variants; (3) create a lightweight risk-hedge matrix and capacity commitments for Dedicated bursts; (4) hand off precise runbooks to Oncall and Infra for rollout and rollback. Goals: reduce model-release cognitive load for SRE/Oncall, ensure rollouts are signal-driven not calendar-driven, and encode cost/quality trade-offs in promotable metrics. Out-of-scope: full eval suite creation (we will reuse existing eval harness), major model re-training or architecture changes. Deliverables: OKR lattice (spreadsheet), decision-threshold matrix, canary schedule template per cohort, ops runbook with rollback play, and a short stakeholder sign-off checklist.
acceptance_criteria: OKR lattice spreadsheet completed with owner for each item and aligned to three measurable metrics: latency99, cost-per-1000tokens, and quality-score delta
Decision-threshold matrix specifies numeric gates for canary -> staged -> full promotion and is adoptable by Runtime and SRE teams
Canary schedule templates created for top three customer cohorts and verified with Capacity team for Dedicated burst margins
Ops runbook drafted and reviewed by Oncall lead with at least two simulated rollback rehearsals recorded
Stakeholder sign-off (PM, Eng runtime, SRE, Product Security) captured in comments with links to approvals
